_paper_reported.note: Numbers reported in the paper (arXiv 2507.12050), kept unchanged for context. Table 3: AdaFace-IResNet101 (WebFace12M) face verification/identification accuracy in percent; Tables 1-2: 1M-identity identification time/storage on the authors' i7-11700K with IPCL/HEaaN. The gym extracts real face templates using the pretrained AdaFace backbone but does not reproduce IJB-C or wall-clock HE timings, so none of these values are on the gym's scale or targets it must match.

face_benchmark_accuracy.description: Paper Table 3: AdaFace-IResNet101 face verification/identification accuracy with and without IDFace.

lfw_accuracy.description: Context-only paper verification accuracy on LFW; not scored by the portable local gym.

cfp_fp_accuracy.description: Context-only paper verification accuracy on CFP-FP; not scored by the portable local gym.

agedb_accuracy.description: Context-only paper verification accuracy on AgeDB; not scored by the portable local gym.

ijbc_identification_tpir_fpir_1e-2.description: Context-only paper IJB-C identification TPIR at FPIR 1e-2; not scored by the portable local gym.

ijbc_identification_tpir_fpir_1e-3.description: Context-only paper IJB-C identification TPIR at FPIR 1e-3; not scored by the portable local gym.

efficiency_1m.description: Paper Table 2 and Table 1: 1M-identity identification efficiency and operation counts.

identify_seconds.description: Context-only paper wall-clock identification time retained only so reported paper rows validate; it is not scored by the portable local gym.

storage_gb.description: Context-only paper storage footprint for 1M identities; not scored by the portable local gym.

ciphertext_multiplications_per_query.description: Context-only paper encrypted multiplication count; the gym enforces fixed encrypted-cost budgets from raw integer codes.

ciphertext_rotations_per_query.description: Context-only paper count of encrypted rotations per query; the portable gym scores its own artifact metadata instead.

face_identification.description: Protected identification at the paper's (alpha, beta) = (341, 341) encrypted-cost operating point: at most 680 ciphertext additions per probe on average in every draw and at least 5 templates packed per 50-bit plaintext slot (codes of dimension <= 512). A run over budget fails.
face_identification.notes: Real AdaFace IR-101 / WebFace12M embeddings from LFW, XQLFW and CPLFW. Identity-disjoint development/test banks; 16 fixed gallery/basis draws with 1200 enrolled identities each, up to 8 probes per identity. This is a scaled open-set protocol, not IJB-C; paper numbers stay under _paper_reported. Hidden labels, partition and basis seeds are confined to eval/test. Every scored quantity is recomputed from encoder codes.

tpir_at_fpir_0.01.description: Primary. Open-set true positive identification rate: fraction of genuine probes whose true identity is the strict unique top match and scores above the threshold at which 1% of impostor probes are falsely accepted (threshold set from the benchmark's own impostor probes).

tpir_at_fpir_0.001.description: Open-set TPIR at the stricter 0.1% false-positive identification rate.

tpir_at_fpir_0.1.description: Open-set TPIR at the looser 10% false-positive identification rate.

top1_identification.description: Closed-set rank-1 identification rate; ties with any wrong identity count as errors.

mean_reciprocal_rank.description: Mean reciprocal rank of the true identity; tied wrong identities rank ahead of it.

open_set_score_auc.description: Probability that a genuine probe's true-identity score exceeds an impostor probe's highest gallery score (ties count one half).

face_identification_compressed.description: Protected identification at the paper's compressed (alpha, beta) = (341, 63) operating point: at most 124 ciphertext additions per probe on average in every draw and at least 8 templates packed per 50-bit plaintext slot (codes of dimension <= 512). A run over budget fails.
